claim_text: Valve added individual binding arbitration and a class-action waiver to the Steam Subscriber Agreement in 2012.
wording_guardrail: Do not imply the provision itself was unlawful.

claim_text: In 2021 the federal court compelled the consumer plaintiffs' claims to arbitration while publisher claims continued separately.
corroboration: District order summarizes the earlier ruling; class site confirms separate publisher matter
wording_guardrail: Keep the consumer arbitration and publisher class action distinct.

claim_text: The underlying antitrust assertions are allegations rather than adjudicated findings.
wording_guardrail: Always attribute the antitrust theory and avoid liability language.

claim_text: The first coordinated claimant group contained 997 individual arbitration demands.
wording_guardrail: Describe as demands filed; not victories or validated claims.

claim_text: At the cited stage 4,991 claimants were pursuing AAA arbitration against Valve.
wording_guardrail: Attribute to the order and cited stage; not 4,991 victories.

claim_text: AAA's mass-arbitration schedule uses initiation, per-case, appointment and final fees plus separate arbitrator compensation.
wording_guardrail: Do not calculate a global Valve obligation without authenticated invoices and payment records.

claim_text: The reviewed record does not establish a single verified 20-million-dollar Valve invoice, payment obligation or court-ordered amount.
corroboration: Court order and schedule do not establish the viral total
wording_guardrail: Keep the number excluded except as an explicitly rejected unverified claim.

claim_text: Four claimants sought dismissal of their arbitrations in May 2024 and an arbitrator granted those requests in July so the claims could be pursued in court.
wording_guardrail: Do not merge these four matters into the later defendant group.

claim_text: On September 26, 2024 Valve removed mandatory arbitration and the class-action waiver and directed unresolved disputes to court.
corroboration: Company announcement, agreement and court order
wording_guardrail: Do not infer an undocumented motive for the change.

claim_text: The updated court clause stated that it applied to claims arising before the new agreement or a prior agreement.
wording_guardrail: Whether it controls pending arbitrations is disputed and on appeal.

claim_text: Valve said 454 of 572 later defendants affirmatively accepted the update and 118 later logged in without affirmative acceptance.
corroboration: Evidence summarized by the district court
wording_guardrail: Retain Valve attribution; do not state acceptance as finally adjudicated.

claim_text: Defendants claimed average Steam libraries worth more than 3,000 dollars; Valve disputed that figure.
corroboration: Both positions summarized in the order
wording_guardrail: Present the number as disputed and unnecessary to the core conclusion.

claim_text: AAA declined Valve's request to administratively close the pending arbitrations and directed arbitrability questions to courts or merits arbitrators.
wording_guardrail: Do not describe AAA's response as a merits ruling against Valve.

claim_text: Arbitral outcomes described in the record were mixed, including stays and results for both Valve and some claimants.
wording_guardrail: Never say all arbitrators ruled against Valve.

claim_text: Valve filed the federal action on October 18, 2024 naming 624 respondents and later filed an August 21, 2025 complaint against 572 defendants.
wording_guardrail: Explain that changing counts do not show one global settlement.

claim_text: By the May 2026 hearing Valve represented that roughly 400 matters remained active.
corroboration: Hearing representation summarized in the order
wording_guardrail: Use roughly and retain Valve attribution; defendants disputed an exact count.

claim_text: On May 27, 2026 the district court denied Valve's motion for a preliminary injunction.
wording_guardrail: Motion loss only; not final antitrust liability or a final contract judgment.

claim_text: At the preliminary stage the court found Valve unlikely to succeed and treated the retroactive clause as procedurally and substantively unconscionable as applied to these defendants.
wording_guardrail: Preserve preliminary posture and as-applied scope.

claim_text: On July 30, 2026 the district court certified the controlling contract question for interlocutory appeal and stayed the case.
wording_guardrail: Certification reflects a contestable legal question; it does not reverse Dkt. 169.

claim_text: The Ninth Circuit opened appeal 26-6269 on September 25, 2026 and no appellate merits decision had issued as of October 7, 2026.
wording_guardrail: Time-sensitive; refresh with official docket at Stage 16 and before publication.

claim_text: The initial public schedule listed Valve's opening brief for November 4, 2026 and the answering brief for December 4, 2026.
wording_guardrail: Dates may change; omit or update after docket refresh.

claim_text: Individual-only dispute design can recreate aggregate pressure through thousands of repeated procedures without becoming one class proceeding.
corroboration: Supported synthesis of filing scale and fee mechanics
wording_guardrail: Frame as structural analysis rather than a legal holding.

claim_text: Valve v. Abbruzzese, the publisher class action, individual award cases and Valve v. Bucher Law are distinct proceedings.
wording_guardrail: Never merge parties, findings or outcomes across proceedings.
